name: watchbug
description: Watchbug — open-source, self-hostable bug-reporting and visual-feedback SDK (npm workspaces monorepo).

scripts.build: npm run build -w @watchbug/contracts && npm run build -w @watchbug/sdk && npm run build -w @watchbug/api && npm run build -w @watchbug/panel
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:contract && npm run test:vrt && npm run test:packaging
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
